finding.observed: Desktop check after PR #44 (Auto, engine 2.1.309), 2026-10-31 12:57-1:00 AM EDT. The message field kept a blue focus ring. Copy IDs sat flush under the field. After the pane was closed nothing offered it back. A follow-up row showed NativePeers' routing envelope (peer key, message, exchange, expiry and envelope hash). An ls -la output filled the narrow pane with wrapped lines.
finding.cause: The field took autofocus and the desktop app rings a focused field; InputProps offers no styling, so the ring shows only while the person types once autofocus is gone. The band passed on the desktop app whenever it drew, pane open or not. The row used task.started's input_preview, which is the rendered message the worker receives (presentation.render).
